description: public.rtf from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened /private/tmp/rclip-capture/styled.rtf (a hand-written RTF with bold/italic/both runs, two fonts, a red colour-table entry and one \'e9 accent), then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: TextEdit's Cocoa RTF writer: \cocoartf2822, a {\*\expandedcolortbl} alongside the plain \colortbl, the accent emitted as the Windows-1252 hex escape \'e9 under \ansicpg1252 rather than as \u233, and '\' + newline as the paragraph mark. Note the font table has one entry per style (Helvetica, Helvetica-Bold, Helvetica-Oblique, Helvetica-BoldOblique) instead of using \b and \i alone.
